reason: Bisulfite sequencing for FAM46C methylation was run only on the eleven gastric-cancer cell lines, while the 129 patient tissues had only mRNA expression measured.
RND1 promoter methylation was examined using individual-level TCGA and GSE14520 methylation data linked to overall survival across three HCC cohorts.
This is a case series of targeted next-generation sequencing for somatic mutations in NSCLC with no methylation, histone, or chromatin assay reported.
Placental LINE1, NR3C1 and IGF2 methylation were measured by pyrosequencing in 80 mother-newborn pairs and linked to in utero PBDE exposure.
HDAC4 and SIRT6 levels were assessed only as Western blot protein expression, not as a measured histone modification.
Three histone post-translational marks (H3K36me2, H3K36me3, H3K79me2) were measured in PBMCs within a randomized folic-acid trial in arsenic-exposed adults.
Blood DNA methylomes across ~483,000 CpGs were profiled in a two-generation cohort and linked to childhood malnutrition exposure and later attention/cognition.
The decision-tree analysis is built entirely on nuclear cytology features of thyroid FNA smears with no epigenetic assay.
hTERT promoter methylation was quantified by MS-PCR in 78 meningiomas and 38 hemangiopericytomas and related to WHO grade, recurrence and survival.
The study reports SEER registry completeness for recording an MGMT-methylation field rather than measuring methylation values in patients.
Saliva-derived DRD/COMT/AKT1 promoter methylation was measured by q-MSP in a methamphetamine-dependency case-control design and linked to psychosis and drug exposure.
Neutrophil fluorescence quantifies chromatin decondensation as a structural NETosis readout of cell activation, not a regulatory epigenetic mark, akin to the sperm chromatin integrity exclusion.
This is a quality-improvement study of emergency-department time-to-antibiotics with no epigenetic marker of any kind.
Urine OTX1/ONECUT2/TWIST1 methylation was assayed alongside FGFR3/TERT/HRAS mutations in a 200-patient hematuria case-control cohort to select patients for cystoscopy.
Genome-wide bisulfite profiling identified DNA methylation of microRNA promoter regions in cholangiocarcinoma tissue, validated in two patient cohorts and linked to patient outcome.
Global histone H4 acetylation in PBMCs was directly measured in amateur runners versus sedentary controls in relation to exercise exposure.
This phase 2 trial reports clinical response to clofarabine/cytarabine after hypomethylating-agent failure without measuring any methylation marker.
ARNTL CpG methylation was measured by pyrosequencing in blood from bipolar-disorder patients versus controls, distinguishing diagnostic groups.
MethylCap-seq identified genome-wide hypermethylated regions validated by qMSP in cervical scrapings for detection of adeno- and squamous-cell carcinoma.
Promoter methylation of a six-gene panel was measured by qMSP in plasma and sputum to diagnose node-negative NSCLC in a case-control design.
Methylation of LRRC3B, APC, FHIT and RASSF1 in plasma cell-free DNA was measured in renal-cancer patients versus healthy donors for diagnostic use.
Global leukocyte DNA methylation was measured by ELISA in a cross-sectional cohort of postmenopausal women and related to cardiovascular risk stratification.
PITX2 and PANCR promoter methylation were measured by qMSP in 399 head-and-neck cancer patients and used to predict overall survival.
Quantitative DNA methylation was measured in maternal and cord-blood plasma across a 40-dyad birth cohort and linked to maternal lipid metabolite exposure.
This molecular profiling of unclassified renal cell carcinoma reports somatic mutations in chromatin regulators (SETD2, BAP1) rather than a directly measured methylation or histone mark.
Dot1l was assessed only by immunohistochemical protein expression in renal cancer tissue, not by measuring the H3K79 methylation mark it deposits.

HSF1 methylation was checked in TCGA only to explain protein upregulation and was found unrelated to it, leaving unclear whether methylation itself was linked to the prognostic decision this record targets.
Genome-wide 450K methylation was measured in PBMCs of discordant Parkinson's siblings/twins and validated in two independent case-control cohorts for a diagnostic CpG signature.
PITX3 promoter methylation was measured by qPCR and 450K array in TCGA and institutional prostatectomy cohorts to predict biochemical recurrence.
A six-gene methylation score was quantified by pyrosequencing in a watchful-waiting prostate cancer cohort and used to predict cancer death.
hTERT CpG-island methylation was measured by MSP in 50 paired invasive breast cancers and normal tissue for diagnostic biomarker development.
Epigenetic age (DNAm clock) was measured in the Women's Health Initiative cohort and linked to insomnia symptoms and sleep duration.
RECK promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite PCR across 112 human oral tissue samples spanning normal to invasive tumor stages.
MALDI imaging mass spectrometry identified histone proteins only as one of several abundance clusters, not a measured histone modification.
CDO1 promoter methylation was measured by qPCR and TCGA 450K array across two prostate cancer cohorts and linked to biochemical recurrence.
A 450K epigenome-wide association study measured blood DNA methylation in current versus never smokers and linked it to cotinine-validated smoking exposure.
Phosphohistone-H3 (a histone modification) was assayed by immunohistochemistry in 160 meningiomas and used as a proliferation index predicting recurrence.
ERCC1/ERCC2/XPC promoter methylation was measured in peripheral blood lymphocytes and skin lesions of arsenicosis patients versus healthy controls.
PDE4D promoter methylation was assessed alongside expression data across prostate tissue datasets and linked to isoform-based diagnostic/prognostic metrics.
GFI1 CpG methylation was measured by bisulfite sequencing in blood from SIDS cases with and without maternal smoking exposure.

DNA methylation marker testing is named as part of the SIMONATH surveillance protocol but no methylation results are reported, so it is unclear whether the marker was actually analysed in this record.
ELOVL2/FHL2 methylation was measured longitudinally in the Doetinchem and Leiden Longevity cohorts and tested against cytomegalovirus status and mortality.
Promoter methylation of ZNF516, FKBP6, INTS1 and HPV16-L1 was measured in cervical brushings and urine cfDNA to triage CIN2+ lesions.
The abstract states genetic, epigenetic and transcriptional alterations were profiled in laterally spreading tumors but never names the specific epigenetic marker or assay used.
A six-CpG methylation panel was measured by array and pyrosequencing in ESCC biopsies to predict chemoradiation response.
RUNX3 promoter methylation at 8 CpG sites was quantified by pyrosequencing in gastric cancer versus normal tissue and linked to prognosis.
Blood DNA methylation was measured by 450K array and pyrosequencing in ovarian cancer patients from the SCOTROC1 platinum-chemotherapy trial and linked to survival.
Plasma histone H4 is measured as a circulating inflammatory protein biomarker in ACLF patients, not as a chromatin-state assay.
ADCY8, CDH8 and ZNF582 promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite-pyrosequencing across cervical cytology grades alongside HPV genotyping.
A 52-CpG methylation signature from TCGA was generated and tested in 523 prostatectomy patients to predict recurrence by Gleason score.
This retrospective outcome analysis compares systemic therapies including HDAC inhibitors in CTCL without measuring any epigenetic marker.
p16 CpG-island methylation was measured by MSP in a 98-case/98-control cervical cancer study and linked to smoking and HPV risk factors.
SHP1-P2 methylation was measured by qPCR in colorectal cancer lymph nodes and linked to occult metastasis detection and prognosis.
This is a 10-case cytomorphology case series of CASTLE thyroid tumors with no comparison group and no epigenetic measurement.
PCDH17 promoter methylation was measured by 450K array and bisulfite sequencing in pediatric ALL diagnostic samples and linked to relapse risk.
H3K23 acetylation, a histone modification, was measured by immunohistochemistry in 121 breast cancer samples and linked to overall survival.
This phase II trial reports clinical response to the HDAC inhibitor romidepsin without measuring any epigenetic marker.
Global DNA methylation subgroup and MGMT promoter methylation status were determined in 152 glioblastoma patients and used as the molecular classification target for an imaging-based classifier.
Pre-diagnostic blood DNA methylation was measured by 450K array in nested case-control cohorts and linked to smoking exposure and lung cancer risk.
CDO1 promoter methylation was measured by Q-MSP in 169 ESCC patients and linked to prognosis and neoadjuvant therapy response.
This claims-database analysis of tympanostomy tube guideline adherence contains no epigenetic measurement.
SFRP3 DNA hypermethylation was evaluated in TCGA methylation data and validated by pyrosequencing in an NSCLC tissue cohort linked to clinical outcome.
Genome-wide 450K methylation profiling compared gallbladder tumor, adjacent, and gallstone tissue with the stated aim of an early-diagnosis biomarker.
Placental LEP promoter methylation was measured by bisulfite-pyrosequencing in the ENVIRONAGE cohort and linked to PM2.5 air-pollution exposure.
p15, p16, p53 and DAPK promoter methylation were measured by MSP in bone marrow across MGUS, SMM, MM and healthy controls to study myelomagenesis staging.
This NAFLD study measures circulating betaine levels and a DMGDH genetic variant, not any directly measured methylation or histone mark.
IGF2 fetal-promoter methylation was measured directly in 228 human HCC tissues compared with adjacent and non-tumor liver, linked to oncogene activation.
Cell-free plasma DNA methylation of DAPK1/DBC1/MIR34A/B/C was measured by pyrosequencing in DLBCL patients and used as an independent prognostic marker.

A novel statistical test is applied to genome-wide methylation data from the Bogalusa cohort, but the record's primary purpose is method development rather than a clearly delineated epidemiological design.
The abstract states a functional study raised methylation at an hOGG1 CpG site but does not specify whether this was measured in the human case-control samples or only in a reporter/functional assay.
MGMT promoter methylation status was determined by PCR in 63 glioblastoma patients and analyzed as a prognostic factor for survival.

Cp-promoter methylation of Epstein-Barr viral DNA (not host DNA) was measured in nasopharyngeal brushings, and it is unclear whether pathogen epigenetic marks fall within this instrument's eligible marker scope.
Myopodin promoter methylation was measured by MS-PCR in 88 kidney tumors and used to predict prognosis and antiangiogenic treatment response.
Placental DNA methylation was measured genome-wide by 450K array in the INMA birth cohort and linked to maternal smoking during pregnancy.
Nucleotyping quantifies nuclear texture by image cytometry, a structural morphometric readout rather than a directly assayed methylation or histone mark.
HS3ST2, SEPTIN9 and SLIT2 promoter methylation was measured by qMSP in urine from bladder cancer patients for diagnosis and surveillance.
ASS1 gene-body methylation was measured in tumor samples from a randomized mesothelioma trial and correlated with treatment response to arginine deprivation.
MGMT promoter methylation status was assayed in glioblastoma tissue from elderly versus young patient cohorts and compared for therapeutic-target relevance.
This is a genetic-association study of PIWI-piRNA pathway SNPs in melanoma survival; DNA methylation is only mentioned as pathway background, not measured.
RPTOR, MGRN1 and RAPSN blood DNA methylation was measured by 450K array and MassARRAY in breast cancer cases versus healthy controls across four cohorts.
Methylation of 40 tumor-suppressor genes was measured by MS-MLPA in prostate cancer versus healthy prostatic tissue across training and validation sets.
A DNA methylation microarray classifier (EPICUP) was trained on 2790 tumors and validated on 7691 tumors to diagnose the primary site of cancer of unknown origin.
Histone H2AX phosphorylation was measured only in HeLa cells expressing mutant MCM8, not in the human POI patients themselves.
Histone H3-K27M is scored here as a genetic mutation used for WHO tumor classification, not as a directly measured histone modification.
OAS2 promoter methylation was measured at 11 CpG sites by pyrosequencing across psoriasis and two SCC subtypes and linked to disease-specific expression.
MGMT promoter methylation status was determined in 303 glioblastoma patients and 190 TCGA cases and analyzed jointly with hTERT mutation for survival.
SCD1 promoter methylation was measured in blood before and after a controlled one-night total-sleep-deprivation exposure in healthy men.
Telomere length is not one of the eligible epigenetic markers (methylation, histone modification, chromatin state, or DNAm clock) defined by this instrument.
DNA damage (comet assay/γ-H2AX) was measured in myeloma cell lines and xenografts, not as an epigenetic assay in the human bone-marrow samples.
Genome-wide DNA methylation across ~2 million loci was measured in cervical biopsies from HPV+ women and validated in TCGA, tracking progression to carcinoma.
MLH1 promoter methylation testing was performed on IHC-flagged endometrial tumors in a prospective universal Lynch-syndrome screening cohort.
Cord blood IGF2, H19 and LINE1 methylation were measured by pyrosequencing and linked to prenatal perfluoroalkyl acid exposure.
Salivary H3 histone family 3A mRNA was measured as gene expression, not as a histone modification or chromatin mark.
This azacitidine-lenalidomide MDS trial reports clinical response rates without measuring any methylation marker.
Placental PCDHAC1 promoter methylation was measured in a birth cohort and linked to maternal cadmium exposure and fetal growth.
SHOX2 and PTGER4 promoter methylation was measured by real-time PCR in plasma across three case-control cohorts to diagnose lung cancer.
This is a cytomorphology study of nuclear/cytoplasmic features for melanocytic lesion diagnosis, with no epigenetic assay.
Serum methylated vimentin and CIMP-high methylation status were measured in a phase I/II azacitidine/CAPOX trial and correlated with treatment response.
IGF2 methylation was measured in blood at birth and age 7 within the ALSPAC cohort and linked to prenatal diet exposure and ADHD symptoms.
Methylation of IGF2 regulatory regions (DMR0, ICR, H19 promoter) was measured by pyrosequencing to diagnose adrenocortical carcinoma versus adenoma.
